record_title: Exact asymptotics for eventual weighted-representation balance
provenance: Scientific derivation from the finite sign-system reduction in Li--Xu--Yan, with a multivariate central limit theorem, a lattice local limit estimate, and exact finite-count checks documented in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.20385v1 was submitted on 17 September 2026, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The theorem keeps k fixed and treats integer offsets c_T with c_T/sqrt(T) converging to a finite real limit; no uniformity for growing k or larger deviations is claimed. The finite computation is supporting evidence rather than a substitute for the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
